Okay, everybody, that is the end of our tour. Thank you for coming. Today we saw a lot. We started at Times Square at nine, then we went down to the Brooklyn Bridge, and we had lunch in Chinatown. After lunch we took the ferry, and you saw the Statue of Liberty from the water. Many of you bought souvenirs, I know! Tomorrow the tour starts at nine again, if you would like to come back. Have a great evening.

Hi Rodrigo, it is Claire. I saw your photos from New York, and they are beautiful! I went to New York for the first time in 2015, and I did not like it. It was January, and it was very cold. But you went in October, and that is a great month. Please send me the report from the KPI forum today. The team in Paris had a lot of questions. Call me on Thursday, and tell me everything. Bye!

Rodrigo went to New York on October twenty-third. In the first week he had meetings with the global team. On Saturday he went to a museum and saw the Egyptian rooms. On Sunday he took the subway to Brooklyn and walked across the bridge. On his last day he bought a souvenir for his kids.
